banned_regex: \b(?:Active protagonist|Concrete want|Opposition that can win|A choice at the end)\b[\s*_:|—–-]*(?:weak|fail)\b
brief: Workshop this spark into one logline with the recipe (protagonist, want, obstacle, stakes), written so it passes the stress tests. Then report four tests on it, one line each in the form Test: pass, weak, or fail, and one sentence of why: Active protagonist, Concrete want, Opposition that can win, A choice at the end. Keep only the canon the user fixed: name no new characters, and do not decide who left the key or what the chest holds. No preamble.
name: premise-logline
